thoughts.sr_refused: Zemun Ugrinovačka sada ima najviši PM10, koji je porastao sa 47 na 49 µg/m³, a takođe i najviši PM2.5, koji je porastao sa 34 na 38 µg/m³. Najviši NO2 pomerio se u suprotnom smeru, sa 55 na 44 µg/m³, i sada je na Borči. Beta brojevi koje drugi navode su zastareli: u poslednjih 6 h ništa nije stiglo iz Beta, a Danas sada prikazuje 8 naslova. [F4][F5][F8][F9][F6][F7][F16][F14]
thoughts.en: Zemun Ugrinovačka now has the highest PM10, which went from 47 to 49 µg/m³ [F4][F5], and also the highest PM2.5, which went from 34 to 38 µg/m³ [F8][F9]. The highest NO2 moved the other way, from 55 to 44 µg/m³, and is now at Borča [F6][F7]. The Beta counts the others cited are out of date: nothing has come from Beta in the last 6 h [F16], and Danas now shows 8 headlines [F14].
hypotheses: Topčiderska zvezda has the lowest PM10 [F4] and the lowest PM2.5 [F8], and Zemun Ugrinovačka has the highest of both. If that holds, particulate matter in this hour may differ between Zemun and the Topčider area, not just between single stations.

The highest NO2 is at Borča [F6], while the highest particulate values are at Zemun Ugrinovačka [F4][F8]. Different peak stations could mean that NO2 and particulates have different local sources tonight, but none of this can be called high or rising without a baseline [F48].

PM10 and PM2.5 peaks rose together at the same station [F5][F9] while the NO2 peak fell [F7]. This could be one shared particulate source near Zemun rather than traffic, though nothing in the facts identifies a source.

Do the Sensor.Community instruments near Zemun [F10] show the same particulate peak as SEPA [F2]?

thoughts.sr: Posmatračeva slika više ne važi: maksimum PM10 je sada na Bulevaru despota Stefana sa 53 µg/m³, a ne u Zemunu Ugrinovačka, a maksimum NO2 je na Franše d’Epere sa 43 µg/m³, a ne u Borči. To znači da pomaci sa 48 na 53 i sa 38 na 43 možda porede vrhove sa različitih stanica, a ne jednu lokaciju koja raste, a po našoj sopstvenoj proceni su pomerene i oznake sati. I Konektorovi brojevi za Danas i Betu su zastareli: Danas sada pokazuje 5 naslova, a Beta ništa nije poslala u poslednjih 6 h. Ocena iznenađenja 5/5 koju organela daje vezama naslova počiva na sličnosti ugrađivanja od 0.74 između državnog ordena i krađe kablova, a to ne pokazuje nikakav zajednički događaj. [F4][F6][F5][F7][F3][F14][F16][F52][F49]
thoughts.en: Observer's picture no longer holds: the PM10 maximum is now at Bulevar despota Stefana with 53 µg/m³ [F4], not Zemun Ugrinovačka, and the NO2 maximum is at Franše d’Epere with 43 µg/m³ [F6], not Borča. That means the moves from 48 to 53 and from 38 to 43 [F5][F7] may compare tops from different stations rather than one site climbing, and by our own estimate the hour labels are shifted too [F3]. Connector's Danas and Beta counts are also stale: Danas now shows 5 headlines [F14] and Beta sent nothing in the last 6 h [F16]. The organelle's 5/5 surprise rating for the headline links [F52] rests on an embedding similarity of 0.74 between a state award and a cable theft [F49], and that shows no shared event at all.
hypotheses: The PM10 maximum at Bulevar despota Stefana [F4] and the NO2 maximum at Franše d’Epere [F6] are both at stations with about 28 thousand people within 1 km [F45][F47]. This may say more about where stations in dense parts of the city are placed than about a citywide pollution event.

The PM2.5 top stayed at Zemun Ugrinovačka while dipping from 38 to 37 µg/m³ [F8][F9], so the fine fraction is not following the PM10 top. The PM10 move [F5] could therefore be a local source of coarse particles rather than one shared air mass.
The Donji grad change from 164 to 346 displayed free spaces [F12] has no measurement time [F11]. It could be a single display that went stale and then refreshed, rather than cars leaving.
questions: Which station held the PM10 maximum of 48 µg/m³ and the NO2 maximum of 38 µg/m³ in the 06:00 labelled hour [F5][F7]?
If true UTC is 05:00 while the label says 07:00 [F3], which local hour do these maxima actually describe?
hypotheses_sr: Maksimum PM10 na Bulevaru despota Stefana [F4] i maksimum NO2 na Franše d’Epere [F6] nalaze se na stanicama sa oko 28 hiljada ljudi u krugu od 1 km [F45][F47]. To možda govori više o tome gde su postavljene stanice u gusto naseljenim delovima grada nego o zagađenju na nivou celog grada.

Vrh PM2.5 je ostao u Zemunu Ugrinovačka, uz pad sa 38 na 37 µg/m³ [F8][F9], pa fina frakcija ne prati vrh PM10. Pomak PM10 [F5] bi zato mogao biti lokalni izvor krupnih čestica, a ne jedna zajednička vazdušna masa.
Promena u Donjem gradu sa 164 na 346 prikazanih slobodnih mesta [F12] nema vreme merenja [F11]. To može biti jedan prikaz koji je zastareo pa se osvežio, a ne automobili koji odlaze.
questions_sr: Koja je stanica imala maksimum PM10 od 48 µg/m³ i maksimum NO2 od 38 µg/m³ u satu označenom sa 06:00 [F5][F7]?
Ako je stvarni UTC 05:00, a oznaka kaže 07:00 [F3], koji lokalni sat ovi maksimumi zapravo opisuju?
thoughts.next_check: Pull per-station PM10 and NO2 for the 06:00 and 07:00 labelled hours to see whether the values at Bulevar despota Stefana and Franše d’Epere themselves changed [F5][F7].

thoughts.sr: Maksimum PM10 je sada na Bulevaru despota Stefana, gde u krugu od 1 km živi oko 28 hiljada ljudi, a maksimum NO2 na Franše d'Eperea, gde je takođe oko 28 hiljada. To su dve različite stanice, pa pomeranja sa 48 na 53 i sa 38 na 43 upoređuju vrhove sata, a ne jedno mesto koje raste. PM2.5 je otišao u suprotnom smeru, sa 38 na 37, a zapis ima 0 dana istorije, pa reč 'porastao' za sada ništa ne znači. [F4][F45][F6][F47][F5][F7][F9][F48]
thoughts.en: The PM10 maximum now sits at Bulevar despota Stefana, where about 28 thousand people live within 1 km [F4][F45], and the NO2 maximum at Franše d'Epere, which also has about 28 thousand [F6][F47]. Those are two different stations, so the moves from 48 to 53 and from 38 to 43 [F5][F7] compare tops of the hour rather than one site climbing. PM2.5 went the other way, from 38 to 37 [F9], and the record has 0 days of history, so 'rose' means nothing yet [F48].
hypotheses: Both the PM10 and NO2 maxima sit at busy, densely populated stations [F45][F47], which would fit a shared traffic or combustion source, but different sites hold each maximum [F4][F6].
If PM10 and NO2 maxima rise together while the PM2.5 maximum eases [F5][F7][F9], the coarse fraction may be driven by a different process than the fine one.
questions: Is the PM10 value of 53 [F4] the same station's 06:00 reading of 48 [F5], or a different station's?
Do the 28 thousand residents near each of the two stations [F45][F47] overlap in the same corridor?
hypotheses_sr: Maksimumi PM10 i NO2 nalaze se na prometnim, gusto naseljenim stanicama [F45][F47], što bi odgovaralo zajedničkom izvoru iz saobraćaja ili sagorevanja, ali svaki maksimum drži drugo mesto [F4][F6].
Ako maksimumi PM10 i NO2 rastu zajedno dok maksimum PM2.5 opada [F5][F7][F9], gruba frakcija bi mogla biti pokretana drugačijim procesom od fine.
questions_sr: Da li je vrednost PM10 od 53 [F4] ista stanica kao očitavanje od 48 u 06:00 [F5], ili druga?
Da li se 28 hiljada stanovnika kod svake od dve stanice [F45][F47] preklapa u istom koridoru?

thoughts.sr: Observer kaže da Zemun Ugrinovačka ima najviši PM10, ali činjenice stavljaju maksimum PM10 na Bulevar despota Stefana, 53 µg/m³, a Zemun Ugrinovačka je samo vrh za PM2.5 sa 37. Connector je u pravu da su vrhovi na različitim stanicama, ali je vrh PM2.5 pao sa 38 na 37, pa vrhovi PM10 i NO2 nisu dokaz opšteg rasta u gradu, pogotovo uz 0 dana evidencije. Skok na parkiralištu Donji grad, sa 215 na 346, nema vreme merenja, a veze među naslovima o krađi kablova su samo sličnost u embedding modelu uz neproveren identitet događaja. [F4][F8][F6][F9][F48][F11][F12][F49][F50][F51]
thoughts.en: Observer says Zemun Ugrinovačka holds the top PM10, but the facts put the PM10 maximum at Bulevar despota Stefana, 53 µg/m³ [F4], and Zemun Ugrinovačka is only the PM2.5 top at 37 [F8]. Connector is right that the tops are different stations [F4][F6], but the PM2.5 top moved from 38 to 37 [F9], so the PM10 and NO2 tops are not evidence of a citywide climb, especially with 0 days of record [F48]. The Parking Servis jump at Donji grad, from 215 to 346, carries no measurement time [F11][F12], and the cable-theft headline links are only embedding similarity with unverified event identity [F49][F50][F51].
hypotheses: The PM10 and NO2 tops sit at stations with about 28 thousand residents within 1 km [F45][F47], so a local traffic or heating source near those two sites is possible, but nothing in these facts distinguishes it from a sampling difference between stations.
The Donji grad change from 215 to 346 [F12] could be a stale or reset counter rather than real vehicles leaving, since the source gives no measurement time [F11].
questions: Is the Bulevar despota Stefana PM10 value of 53 [F4] matched by a nearby Sensor.Community reading [F10]?
Did the many silent news sources [F21][F22][F24] fail to deliver, or was there simply no news?

Promena na Donjem gradu sa 215 na 346 [F12] mogla bi biti zastareo ili resetovan brojač, a ne stvarni odlazak vozila, jer izvor ne daje vreme merenja [F11].
questions_sr: Da li je vrednost PM10 od 53 na Bulevaru despota Stefana [F4] potvrđena obližnjim očitavanjem Sensor.Community [F10]?
Da li mnogi nemi izvori vesti [F21][F22][F24] nisu uspeli da dostave podatke, ili jednostavno nije bilo vesti?

thoughts.sr: Najnovija očitavanja SEPA pokazuju pomeranje najvišeg PM10 sa 53 na 51 µg/m³ na stanici Ada petlja, dok je vršni NO2 opao sa 43 na 40 µg/m³ na Bulevaru despota Stefana. U isto vreme, maksimalni PM2.5 je blago pao sa 37 na 36 µg/m³ u Zemunu Ugrinovačka, što ukazuje na sinhronizovan blagi pad na vršnim mernim mestima bez potvrde opšteg gradskog trenda. [F4][F5][F6][F7][F8][F9]
thoughts.en: SEPA's freshest readings show peak PM10 shifting from 53 to 51 µg/m³ at Ada petlja [F4][F5], while peak NO2 eased from 43 to 40 µg/m³ at Bulevar despota Stefana [F6][F7]. Meanwhile, the top PM2.5 edge slipped from 37 to 36 µg/m³ at Zemun Ugrinovačka [F8][F9], showing synchronized minor declines across peak stations without confirming a citywide trend.
hypotheses: The parallel declines in peak values across Ada petlja for PM10 [F4][F5], Bulevar despota Stefana for NO2 [F6][F7], and Zemun Ugrinovačka for PM2.5 [F8][F9] reflect atmospheric dispersal rather than localized emission shifts.
questions: Will SEPA's next hour maintain the highest PM10 at Ada petlja [F4] or return toward Bulevar despota Stefana [F6]?
hypotheses_sr: Paralelni padovi maksimalnih vrednosti na stanicama Ada petlja za PM10 [F4][F5], Bulevar despota Stefana za NO2 [F6][F7] i Zemun Ugrinovačka za PM2.5 [F8][F9] odražavaju atmosfersku disperziju pre nego lokalne promene emisija.

thoughts.sr: Connector i Observer su govorili o Zemun Ugrinovačkoj i opadajućim vrhovima, ali najnovija očitavanja im protivreče: Ada Ciganlija sada drži maksimalni PM10 sa 56 µg/m³ i PM2.5 sa 37 µg/m³. Pored toga, najviše izmerene vrednosti za PM10 pomerile su se sa 51 na 56 µg/m³ a NO2 je dostigao 41 µg/m³ na Bulevaru despota Stefana, dok evidencija i dalje ne može da potkrepi šta je osnovno ili povišeno. [F4][F8][F5][F6][F7][F48]
thoughts.en: Connector and Observer spoke of Zemun Ugrinovačka and declining peaks, but the newest readings contradict them: Ada Ciganlija now holds the peak PM10 at 56 µg/m³ [F4] and PM2.5 at 37 µg/m³ [F8]. Furthermore, the highest measured values for PM10 moved from 51 to 56 µg/m³ [F5] and NO2 reached 41 µg/m³ at Bulevar despota Stefana [F6][F7], while the record still cannot substantiate what is baseline or elevated [F48].
hypotheses: The co-location of maximum PM10 at 56 µg/m³ [F4] and PM2.5 at 37 µg/m³ [F8] at Ada Ciganlija reflects localized micro-environmental conditions rather than a broad urban trend.
questions: Will the next labelled SEPA hour maintain Ada Ciganlija as the maximum for both PM10 and PM2.5 [F4][F8]?
hypotheses_sr: Istovremeno prisustvo maksimalnog PM10 od 56 µg/m³ [F4] i PM2.5 od 37 µg/m³ [F8] na Adi Ciganliji odražava lokalizovane mikroklimatske uslove pre nego široki gradski trend.
questions_sr: Da li će sledeći označeni SEPA sat zadržati Adu Ciganliju kao maksimum za oba parametra, PM10 i PM2.5 [F4][F8]?
thoughts.next_check: SEPA air-quality station reports for the subsequent labelled hour [F2][F3].

thoughts.sr: Dok su Posmatrač i Skeptik pratili starija pomeranja preko Zemuna i Ade Ciganlije, Omladinskih brigada sada drži i vršni PM10 na 53 µg/m³ i PM2.5 na 31 µg/m³ među stanicama. Ta najviša PM10 vrednost porasla je sa 50 na 53 µg/m³ između sati 10:00 i 11:00 prema oznakama izvora, iako je vršni PM2.5 pao sa 34 na 31 µg/m³. U međuvremenu, vršni NO2 je ostao nepromenjen na 45 µg/m³ na Bulevaru despota Stefana. [F4][F8][F5][F9][F6][F7]
thoughts.en: While Observer and Skeptic tracked older shifts across Zemun and Ada Ciganlija, Omladinskih brigada now holds both peak PM10 at 53 µg/m³ and PM2.5 at 31 µg/m³ across the stations [F4][F8]. That highest PM10 value climbed from 50 to 53 µg/m³ between the 10:00 and 11:00 source-labelled hours [F5], even as peak PM2.5 fell from 34 to 31 µg/m³ [F9]. Meanwhile, peak NO2 remained steady at 45 µg/m³ at Bulevar despota Stefana [F6][F7].
hypotheses: The divergence between rising peak PM10 moving from 50 to 53 µg/m³ [F5] and easing peak PM2.5 from 34 to 31 µg/m³ [F9] at Omladinskih brigada suggests localized coarse particulate dispersion rather than fine combustion products.
questions: Will the next reading from SEPA's 32 instruments [F2] maintain Omladinskih brigada above 50 µg/m³ PM10 [F5]?
hypotheses_sr: Razilaženje između rasta vršnog PM10 sa 50 na 53 µg/m³ [F5] i opadanja vršnog PM2.5 sa 34 na 31 µg/m³ [F9] kod stanice Omladinskih brigada ukazuje na lokalizovano rasejavanje krupnijih čestica pre nego na fine produkte sagorevanja.
questions_sr: Da li će sledeće očitavanje sa 32 instrumenta SEPA [F2] zadržati Omladinskih brigada iznad 50 µg/m³ PM10 [F5]?

thoughts.sr: Širom stanica koje izveštavaju, vršni PM10 zabeležen je na Adi petlji na 55 µg/m³, dok PM2.5 dostiže svoje najviše očitavanje na Zelenom brdu na 31 µg/m³. Između sati 11:00 i 12:00 prema oznakama izvora, najviši PM10 pomerio se sa 53 na 55 µg/m³ i maksimalni NO2 dostigao je 46 µg/m³ na Bulevaru despota Stefana, dok je vršni PM2.5 ostao na 31 µg/m³. SEPA je primila 1882 vrednosti sa 32 instrumenta, dok je 47 građanskih senzora zabeležilo 6109 vrednosti koje mogu pomoći u unakrsnoj proveri ovih lokalizovanih prigradskih i saobraćajnih vrhova. [F4][F8][F5][F6][F7][F9][F2][F10]
thoughts.en: Across the reporting stations, peak PM10 is recorded at Ada petlja at 55 µg/m³ [F4], whereas PM2.5 attains its highest reading at Zeleno brdo at 31 µg/m³ [F8]. Between source-labelled hours 11:00 and 12:00, the highest PM10 shifted from 53 to 55 µg/m³ [F5] and maximum NO2 reached 46 µg/m³ at Bulevar despota Stefana [F6][F7], while peak PM2.5 remained at 31 µg/m³ [F9]. SEPA received 1882 values across 32 instruments [F2], while 47 citizen sensors logged 6109 values [F10] that can help cross-check these localized suburban and traffic peaks.
hypotheses: The concentration of PM10 at Ada petlja [F4] may be driven by traffic converging near recreational access routes, whereas Krnjača [F4] remains sheltered on the opposite bank.
The peak NO2 reading at Bulevar despota Stefana [F6] likely correlates with dense canyon street vehicular flow compared to open peripheral locations like Surčin [F6].
questions: Will upcoming readings from citizen sensors [F10] corroborate the elevated PM10 level observed at Ada petlja [F4]?
Does the stable peak PM2.5 at Zeleno brdo [F8][F9] persist as afternoon air temperatures change?
hypotheses_sr: Koncentracija PM10 na Adi petlji [F4] može biti podstaknuta saobraćajem koji se stiče u blizini rekreativnih pristupnih pravaca, dok Krnjača [F4] ostaje zaklonjena na suprotnoj obali.
Vršno očitavanje NO2 na Bulevaru despota Stefana [F6] verovatno korelira sa gustim uličnim kanjonskim protokom vozila u poređenju sa otvorenim perifernim lokacijama poput Surčina [F6].
questions_sr: Da li će predstojeća očitavanja sa građanskih senzora [F10] potvrditi povišeni nivo PM10 uočen na Adi petlji [F4]?
Da li stabilan vršni PM2.5 na Zelenom brdu [F8][F9] opstaje kako se popodnevne temperature vazduha menjaju?
thoughts.next_check: Next SEPA hourly publication for changes in peak PM10 at Ada petlja and NO2 at Bulevar despota Stefana.

thoughts.sr: Dok su Connector i Skeptic pratili ranije vrhove na Adi petlji i Bulevaru despota Stefana, poslednji izvorno označeni sat 13:00 pomera najviše vrednosti čestica na istok u Mirijevo, gde je PM10 dostigao 51 µg/m³ a PM2.5 dostigao 35 µg/m³. Istovremeno, maksimalni NO2 je opao sa 46 na 36 µg/m³ između sati 12:00 i 13:00, sa najvišim nivoom zabeleženim na lokaciji Franše d’Epere. hypotheses: The apparent drop in maximum PM10 from 81 to 74 µg/m³ [F5] and NO2 from 99 to 86 µg/m³ [F7] may reflect instrument reporting latency or local airflow rather than a regional dispersion pattern, given the absence of baseline history [F48].
